one_liner: Frontend cloud for building, deploying, and operating web apps.
access_notes: Self-serve: create a Personal Access Token from Account Tokens or set up an OAuth integration to get client ID/secret. Marketplace listing and broader distribution may require review, but basic credentials do not. Docs: https://vercel.com/docs/rest-api, https://vercel.com/docs/accounts/access-tokens, https://vercel.com/docs/integrations/create-integration
mcp_notes: Official Vercel MCP server at https://mcp.vercel.com (OAuth-based). See https://vercel.com/docs/mcp

evidence.quote: Vercel Access Tokens are required to authenticate and use the Vercel API… Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>… Create and manage Access Tokens in your account settings.
Create a Vercel API access token from your personal account’s Account Tokens page… Personal access tokens begin with the prefix vcp_… Pass the token as a Bearer token in the Authorization header.
Vercel’s IdP uses the OAuth 2.0 authorization framework… Access Token: A bearer token your application uses to call the Vercel REST API… lasts for 1 hour. Refresh Token… lasts for 30 days.

Once your integration is approved, you can share it… If you are interested in having your integration listed… The integration must have at least 500 active installations… please email integrations@vercel.com with your request to be reviewed.
Yes. Vercel MCP is Vercel’s official remote MCP server at https://mcp.vercel.com, and it authorizes clients with OAuth. AI tools can use it to… manage projects and deployments…
